claim.text: RMSNorm divides each coordinate by the root mean square of the vector, so a larger epsilon stops that division from shri

spec.explain: Illustrative toy from arXiv 1910.07467 showing RMSNorm rescaling of one coordinate by the root mean square; the curve shows scaled output falling as epsilon grows past the RMS limit.

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var rms = state.rms; var eps = state.eps; var xval = state.xval; ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); var x0 = 56; var y0 = 22; var pw = w - x0 - 150; var ph = h - y0 - 58; var xMax = 2; var yMax = 6; function X(e) { return x0 + e / xMax * pw; } function Y(s) { return y0 + ph - s / yMax * ph; } ctx.strokeStyle = "#8a8175"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(x0, y0, pw, ph); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.fillText("eps 0", x0, y0 + ph + 18); ctx.fillText("eps 2", x0 + pw, y0 + ph + 18); ctx.fillText("epsilon", x0 + pw / 2, y0 + ph + 34); ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillText("6", 28, Y(6) + 4); ctx.fillText("0", 28, Y(0) + 4); ctx.fillText("scaled", 28, y0 - 6); var thr = rms * rms; var clipped = 0; var i = 0; var e = 0; var s = 0; var px = 0; var py = 0; if (thr >= 0 && thr <= xMax) { ctx.strokeStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; var yt = y0; while (yt < y0 + ph) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(X(thr), yt); ctx.lineTo(X(thr), yt + 6); ctx.stroke(); yt = yt + 12; } ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillText("rms^2", X(thr) + 6, y0 + 14); } ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); for (i = 0; i <= 60; i++) { e = i / 60 * xMax; s = xval / Math.sqrt(rms * rms + e); px = X(e); py = Y(s); if (s > yMax) { py = y0; clipped = 1; } if (i === 0) { ctx.moveTo(px, py); } else { ctx.lineTo(px, py); } } ctx.stroke(); var denom = Math.sqrt(rms * rms + eps); var scaled = xval / denom; var cpy = Y(scaled); var cpx = X(eps); var dotClipped = 0; if (scaled > yMax) { cpy = y0; dotClipped = 1; } ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cpx, y0 + ph); ctx.lineTo(cpx, cpy); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cpx, cpy, 6, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cpx, cpy, 2.5, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); var lx = x0 + pw + 12; ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.textAlign = "left"; ctx.fillText("rms " + Math.round(rms * 100) / 100, lx, y0 + 30); ctx.fillText("eps " + Math.round(eps * 100) / 100, lx, y0 + 52); ctx.fillText("x " + Math.round(xval * 100) / 100, lx, y0 + 74); ctx.fillText("denom " + Math.round(denom * 100) / 100, lx, y0 + 104); ctx.fillText("scaled " + Math.round(scaled * 100) / 100, lx, y0 + 126); ctx.fillStyle = "#8a8175"; ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("x div sqrt(rms^2+eps)", lx, y0 + 152); if (eps > thr) { ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillText("eps past rms^2", lx, y0 + 174); } else { ctx.fillStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.fillText("rms holds", lx, y0 + 174); } if (clipped === 1 || dotClipped === 1) { ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.fillText("clipped", x0 + 8, y0 + 16); } }
